title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-25 11:39:55 最新章节：第五十三章 安凌
slug: 纳玄尘第五十三章安凌
content_zh:
朔州城，瀚北王府。
深秋的风裹着边塞的寒意，穿堂过院，把廊下的灯笼吹得摇摇晃晃。
内院正房里，炭火烧得很旺。
一个十岁的男孩躺在锦被中，脸色苍白，额头渗出细密的汗珠。他已经昏迷了七天七夜。
王府上下急得团团转，朔州城里但凡能请到的大夫全请遍了，药灌了一碗又一碗，烧就是退不下来。
瀚北王妃守在床边，眼睛红肿，声音都哑了。
“尘儿，你倒是睁眼看看娘啊……”
丫鬟青萝端着药碗站在一旁，眼眶也是红的，却还要强撑着安慰王妃：“王妃娘娘，世子爷吉人自有天相，肯定会醒过来的。”
这话说了七天了，每天都说，说完连自己都觉得底气不足。
就在这时，床上的男孩忽然皱了皱眉。
王妃猛地站起来，一把抓住他的手：“尘儿？尘儿你醒了吗？娘在这里！”
男孩的眼皮动了动。
很慢。
像是有千钧之重压在眼帘上。
然后，他睁开了眼睛。
那是一双极其复杂的眼睛。
初看是十岁孩童的清澈，可再多看一眼，就能发现那双眸子里藏着不属于这个年纪的东西——太深了，太沉了，像是一口望不到底的古井。
苏尘睁着眼，没有动。
他在消化。
无数记忆如同决堤的洪水，从他脑海深处翻涌而出，猛烈撞击着他尚未完全清醒的意识。

首先是第一世。
画面的碎片从远处飘来——高楼大厦，车水马龙，键盘敲击的声音，法庭上庄严肃穆的国徽。他坐在公诉席上，逐条陈述证据，面对辩护律师的质疑沉着应对。审讯室里，嫌疑人在他面前崩溃。办公室里，卷宗堆成小山，他一边喝着浓茶一边整理证据链。
那是朝九晚五的日子。平淡，安稳，却也充实。
他记得那个世界的一切。
然后画面骤变。
夜，深宫。
一个年轻的小太监跪在冰冷的地砖上，额头贴着地面，浑身颤抖。面前站着一个穿蟒袍的中年男人，那是当时权倾朝野的大太监。
“抬起头来。”
小太监战战兢兢地抬头。
大太监看了他一眼，说了一句改变他命运的话：“这孩子眼里有东西，留下吧。”
于是有了曹钦。
这个名字，曾经让整个苍玄王朝闻风丧胆。
从最底层的洒扫太监，到内廷的掌印太监，再到创立玄镜司、权倾朝野的“玄镜公”——曹钦只用了不到二十年。
他为当今皇帝夺嫡立下了汗马功劳。皇帝登基那年，玄镜司正式成立，曹钦任督主，一人之下，万人之上。
朝中文武百官，谁贪了多少钱、养了几个外室、和谁结党营私——没有玄镜司不知道的事。
那时候的曹钦，往朝堂上一站，连一品大员都要低着头说话。
民间有人私下说，玄镜公离“万岁”只差一步了。
可曹钦知道，这句话是催命符。
画面再次翻转。
那是一个春暖花开的午后。

玄镜司后院的凉亭里，一个年轻俊朗的男子跪在曹钦面前，恭恭敬敬地磕了三个头。
“义父在上，请受孩儿一拜。”
content_en:
Shuozhou City, Hanbei Palace.
The late autumn wind carried the chill of the frontier fortress, passing through the halls and courtyards, blowing the lanterns in the corridors swaying.
In the main room of the inner courtyard, the charcoal fire was burning brightly.
A ten-year-old boy was lying on the brocade quilt, his face was pale, and beads of sweat oozed from his forehead. He had been in a coma for seven days and nights.
The whole palace was in a state of panic, and all the doctors available in Shuozhou City were invited. Bowl after bowl of medicine was given to him, but the fever could not go away.
Princess Hanbei was standing by the bed, her eyes were red and swollen, and her voice was hoarse.
"Chen'er, please open your eyes and look at mother..."
The maid Qingluo stood aside with a medicine bowl, her eyes were also red, but she still tried to comfort the princess: "Princess, the prince has his own destiny, and he will definitely wake up."
I have been saying this for seven days, saying it every day, and even I feel that I am not confident enough after saying it.
At this moment, the boy on the bed suddenly frowned.
The princess stood up suddenly and grabbed his hand: "Chen'er? Chen'er, are you awake? Mother is here!"
The boy's eyelids moved.
Very slow.
It was like there was a huge weight pressing on my eyes.
Then he opened his eyes.
Those are an extremely complex pair of eyes.
At first glance, it looks like the clarity of a ten-year-old child, but if you take a second look, you will find that there is something hidden in those eyes that does not belong to this age - too deep, too heavy, like an ancient well that cannot be seen to the bottom.
Su Chen opened his eyes and did not move.
He is digesting.
Countless memories surged out from the depths of his mind like a flood that broke a bank, violently impacting his consciousness that was not yet fully awake.
First is the first life.
Fragments of the picture floated from a distance - tall buildings, busy traffic, the sound of keyboard tapping, the solemn national emblem in the courtroom. He sat in the prosecutor's seat, presented the evidence point by point, and responded calmly to the defense lawyer's questions. In the interrogation room, the suspect collapsed in front of him. In the office, files were piled up in a mountain, and he was sorting out the chain of evidence while drinking strong tea.
It was a 9 to 5 day. Plain, stable, but also fulfilling.
He remembers everything about that world.
Then the screen suddenly changed.
Night, deep in the palace.
A young eunuch knelt on the cold floor tiles, his forehead pressed to the ground and his whole body trembling. Standing in front of him was a middle-aged man wearing a python robe. He was the powerful eunuch at that time.
"Keep your head up."
The little eunuch raised his head tremblingly.
The big eunuch glanced at him and said something that changed his fate: "There is something in this kid's eyes, keep it."
So there was Cao Qin.
This name once made the entire Cangxuan Dynasty fearful.
It only took Cao Qin less than twenty years to go from the lowest eunuch, to the eunuch in charge of the inner court, to the "Xuanjing Gong" who founded the Xuanjing Division and dominated the government and the public.
He made great contributions to the current emperor's succession. In the year when the emperor ascended the throne, the Xuanjing Division was formally established, and Cao Qin was appointed as the governor, with one person under him and ten thousand people above him.
Among the civil and military officials of the DPRK, there was nothing that Xuan Jingsi didn't know about who had embezzled how much money, how many concubines he had, and who he had formed cliques with for personal gain.
At that time, when Cao Qin stood in the court hall, even the first-rank officials would lower their heads and speak.
Some people said privately that Xuan Jinggong was only one step away from "long live".
But Cao Qin knew that these words were a reminder.
The screen flips again.
It was a warm spring afternoon.
In the pavilion in the backyard of Xuanjingsi, a young and handsome man knelt in front of Cao Qin and kowtowed three times respectfully.
"My foster father is here, please accept my child's respect."
